## 2. Global North / South classification

```{r}
region_lookup <- tribble(
  ~country.x,      ~region,
  "China",         "South",
  "France",        "North",
  "Singapore",     "North",   
  "USA",           "North",
  "Italy",         "North",
  "Germany",       "North",
  "Japan",         "North",
  "Australia",     "North",
  "UK",            "North",
  "Spain",         "North",
  "Greece",        "North",
  "Brazil",        "South",
  "Belgium",       "North",
  "Mauritius",     "South",
  "Bermuda",       "North",
  "Israel",        "North",   
  "Netherlands",   "North",
  "New Zealand",   "North",
  "South Korea",   "North",  
  "Morocco",       "South",
  "Canada",        "North",
  "Denmark",       "North",
  "India",         "South",
  "Cape Verde",    "South",
  "South Africa",  "South",
  "Portugal",      "North",
  "Chile",         "South",   
  "Tunisia",       "South",
  "Cyprus",        "North",
  "Croatia",       "North",
  "Monaco",        "North",
  "Grenada",       "South"
)
```


```{r}
home_continent <- df %>%
  count(country.x, continent.x) %>%
  group_by(country.x) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(country.x, home_continent = continent.x)

exclave_rows <- df %>%
  distinct(country.x, continent.x) %>%
  left_join(home_continent, by = "country.x") %>%
  filter(continent.x != home_continent)

exclave_rows  

north_exceptions <- c("Israel", "Japan", "South Korea", "Republic of Korea", "Australia", "New Zealand")

classify_by_continent <- function(country, continent) {
  continent_l <- tolower(continent)
  case_when(
    country %in% north_exceptions ~ "North",
    str_detect(continent_l, "europe") ~ "North",
    str_detect(continent_l, "north america") ~ "North",
    TRUE ~ "South"
  )
}

df <- df %>%
  left_join(region_lookup, by = "country.x") %>%
  mutate(
    is_exclave = paste(country.x, continent.x) %in% paste(exclave_rows$country.x, exclave_rows$continent.x),
    region = if_else(is_exclave, classify_by_continent(country.x, continent.x), region),
    country_id = if_else(is_exclave, paste0(country.x, " (", continent.x, ")"), country.x)
  )

df %>% distinct(country_id, country.x, continent.x, region, is_exclave) %>% arrange(desc(is_exclave), country_id)

NO_REGION_COUNTRIES <- c("Antarctica")

unmatched_countries <- df %>%
  filter(is.na(region), !country.x %in% NO_REGION_COUNTRIES) %>%
  distinct(country.x)
if (nrow(unmatched_countries) > 0) {
  warning("Countries missing from region_lookup -- add them before trusting any North/South result: ",
          paste(unmatched_countries$country.x, collapse = ", "))
}
unmatched_countries

```

```{r prep-d}

  filter(carrier == "plastisphere") %>%
  mutate(
    type = factor(type, levels = c("patho_bacteria","patho_fungi","toxic_algae","ARGs")),
```

```{r fig1-quadrant-data}
  group_by(type) %>%
  mutate(mass_scaled = rescale11(mass_mean),

         hazard_scaled = rescale11(hazard_mean),
         hazard_se_scaled = hazard_se * 2 / (max(hazard_mean) - min(hazard_mean))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r fig1-northsouth-tests}

library(metafor)

run_meta <- function(data, yi_col, se_col) {
  complete <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[se_col]]))
  excluded <- nrow(data) - nrow(complete)
  se_floor <- min(complete[[se_col]][complete[[se_col]] > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  complete <- complete %>%
    mutate(se_used = if_else(.data[[se_col]] <= 0, se_floor, .data[[se_col]]))
  n_floored <- sum(complete[[se_col]] <= 0)

  fit <- rma(yi = complete[[yi_col]], sei = complete$se_used,
             mods = ~ region, data = complete, method = "REML")
  pred_North <- predict(fit, newmods = 0)
  pred_South <- predict(fit, newmods = 1)
  tibble(
    n_countries_used = nrow(complete), n_excluded_no_se = excluded,
    n_se_floored = n_floored, se_floor_value = se_floor,
    tau2 = fit$tau2, estimate_South_minus_North = fit$beta["regionSouth", 1],
    se = fit$se[2], statistic = fit$zval[2], p = fit$pval[2],
    mean_North = pred_North$pred, ci_lb_North = pred_North$ci.lb, ci_ub_North = pred_North$ci.ub,
    mean_South = pred_South$pred, ci_lb_South = pred_South$ci.lb, ci_ub_South = pred_South$ci.ub
  )
}

mass_meta <- run_meta(country_mass, "mass_mean", "mass_se")
mass_meta %>% mutate(pair = "mass", .before = 1)

hazard_meta <- map_dfr(levels(country_hazard$type), function(h) {
  sub <- filter(country_hazard, type == h) %>% mutate(region = droplevels(region))
  res <- run_meta(sub, "hazard_mean", "hazard_se")
  tibble(type = h, n_North = sum(sub$region == "North"), n_South = sum(sub$region == "South")) %>%
    bind_cols(res)
})
hazard_meta

```

## fig5

```{r fig2-cp-er-hs-data}
NA_THRESHOLD <- 0.5
rescale01 <- function(x) (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE))

value_indicators <- c("Marine ecosystems occurrence","Proportion of marine protected areas",
                       "Biodiversity intactness index","Proportion of forests","Coastal vegetation NDVI")
human_indicators <- c("Coastal tourism density","Gridded GDP per capita based on PPP in 2015")
cp_indicators <- c("Nutrient pollution","Organic pollution")

build_composite <- function(df, indicators, out_name, na_threshold = NA_THRESHOLD) {
  na_pct <- df %>% select(all_of(indicators)) %>% summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(is.na(.x))))
  kept <- names(na_pct)[as.numeric(na_pct[1, ]) <= na_threshold]
  df %>% mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(kept), rescale01)) %>%
    rowwise() %>% mutate("{out_name}" := mean(c_across(all_of(kept)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>% select(row_id, all_of(out_name))
}

d_all <- df %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(build_composite(df, value_indicators, "eco_value"), by = "row_id") %>%
  left_join(build_composite(df, human_indicators, "human_value"), by = "row_id") %>%
  left_join(build_composite(df, cp_indicators, "cp_score"), by = "row_id")


site_static <- d_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
  group_by(country_id, region, latitude, longitude) %>%
  summarise(
    mass_conc          = first(`2020_mass_concentration_total`),
    eco_value          = first(eco_value),
    human_value        = first(human_value),
    cp_score           = first(cp_score),
    n_distinct_mass    = n_distinct(`2020_mass_concentration_total`, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_distinct_eco     = n_distinct(eco_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_distinct_human   = n_distinct(human_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_distinct_cp      = n_distinct(cp_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(mass_log = log10(mass_conc * 1e6))

inconsistent_sites <- site_static %>%
  filter(n_distinct_mass > 1 | n_distinct_eco > 1 | n_distinct_human > 1 | n_distinct_cp > 1)
if (nrow(inconsistent_sites) > 0) {
  warning(nrow(inconsistent_sites),
          " site(s) have inconsistent mass/eco/human/cp values across rows -- inspect before trusting site_static: ",
          paste(inconsistent_sites$country_id, collapse = ", "))
}
inconsistent_sites

site_hazard_summary <- d_all %>%
  filter(carrier == "plastisphere", !is.na(hazard_rel_abundance), !is.na(region)) %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("patho_bacteria","patho_fungi","toxic_algae","ARGs")),
         log_hazard = log10(hazard_rel_abundance * 100 + 1)) %>%
  group_by(type, country_id, region, latitude, longitude) %>%
  summarise(hazard_log = mean(log_hazard), n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop")

n_before_join <- nrow(site_hazard_summary)

site_all <- site_hazard_summary %>%
  inner_join(site_static, by = c("country_id","region","latitude","longitude")) %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  mutate(mass_scaled = rescale01(mass_log), hazard_scaled = rescale01(hazard_log),
         exposure = (mass_scaled + hazard_scaled) / 2,
         eco_scaled = rescale01(eco_value), human_scaled = rescale01(human_value),
         cp_scaled = rescale01(cp_score)) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(site_all) != n_before_join) {
  warning("Row count changed after joining site_static (", n_before_join, " -> ", nrow(site_all),
          ") -- site_static is duplicating rows for at least one site; inspect inconsistent_sites above.")
}

classify2x2 <- function(pred, exposure) {
  ph <- pred >= median(pred, na.rm = TRUE)
  eh <- exposure >= median(exposure, na.rm = TRUE)
  case_when(
    is.na(ph) | is.na(eh) ~ NA_character_,
    ph & eh   ~ "high_high",
    !ph & eh  ~ "low_high",
    ph & !eh  ~ "high_low",
    TRUE      ~ "low_low"
  )
}

site_cat <- site_all %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  mutate(cp_cat = classify2x2(cp_scaled, exposure),
         eco_cat = classify2x2(eco_scaled, exposure),
         human_cat = classify2x2(human_scaled, exposure)) %>%
  ungroup()

site_cat %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(n_total = n(),
            n_na_cp = sum(is.na(cp_cat)), n_na_eco = sum(is.na(eco_cat)),
            n_na_human = sum(is.na(human_cat)), .groups = "drop")

site_cat_long <- site_cat %>%
  select(type, latitude, longitude, cp_cat, eco_cat, human_cat) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(cp_cat, eco_cat, human_cat), names_to = "dimension", values_to = "cat") %>%
  mutate(dimension = recode(dimension, cp_cat = "CP", eco_cat = "ER", human_cat = "HS"),
         dimension = factor(dimension, levels = c("CP","ER","HS")))

```

```{r fig2-panel-a, fig.width=13, fig.height=8}
p5a <- ggplot() +
```

```{r fig2-panel-b, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
build_proportions <- function(data, cat_col) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[cat_col]])) %>%
    group_by(type, region) %>%
    summarise(n_total = n(), n_high_high = sum(.data[[cat_col]] == "high_high"),
              pct_high_high = n_high_high / n_total, .groups = "drop")
}

cp_proportions    <- build_proportions(site_cat, "cp_cat")
eco_proportions   <- build_proportions(site_cat, "eco_cat")
human_proportions <- build_proportions(site_cat, "human_cat")

proportion_test <- function(data, count_col) {
  map_dfr(levels(data$type), function(h) {
    sub <- filter(data, type == h)
    n_grp <- sub$n_total
    x_grp <- sub[[count_col]]
    if (nrow(sub) < 2 || any(n_grp == 0)) return(tibble(type = h, p = NA_real_))
    test <- prop.test(x_grp, n_grp)
    tibble(type = h, pct_North = x_grp[sub$region == "North"] / n_grp[sub$region == "North"],
           pct_South = x_grp[sub$region == "South"] / n_grp[sub$region == "South"], p = test$p.value)
  })
}

all_proportion_tests <- bind_rows(
  proportion_test(cp_proportions, "n_high_high")    %>% mutate(dimension = "CP"),
  proportion_test(eco_proportions, "n_high_high")   %>% mutate(dimension = "ER"),
  proportion_test(human_proportions, "n_high_high") %>% mutate(dimension = "HS")
) %>% relocate(dimension, .before = type)

all_proportion_tests

p5b <- bind_rows(
  cp_proportions    %>% mutate(dimension = "CP"),
  eco_proportions   %>% mutate(dimension = "ER"),
  human_proportions %>% mutate(dimension = "HS")
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = region, y = pct_high_high, fill = region)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(pct_high_high, accuracy = 0.1)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors) +
  facet_grid(type ~ dimension) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of sites: high dimension & high exposure") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = "none")

p5b

```
